- Why: the claim assumed the list ⋮ items are built in `objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`. Measured by the developer (report 7090348377): that file builds only the folded narrow-header menu; the list ⋮ that carries the object description and 「Add to favorites」 is `ObjectViewMoreMenu` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx`. My mechanism assumption was wrong, not the card.
- File surface now: the claimed surface **plus** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx` and one new test file beside it. ⛔ Still excluded: `ObjectView.tsx`, `listDraftStore.ts`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`.
- Pre-claim reads for the added file: no open PR touches it (#36525 and #36612 file lists read; #36411 merged); last change on main is #36397; `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 36487 --paths <file>`: no ruling on the card thread, title-only term hits.
- Item 4, read by the area: the card says the jump follows the existing unsaved prompt. List drafts never register with that prompt and are built to survive a departure (measured: after a draft sort, `confirmUnsavedLeave` asked 0 times). The area keeps item 4 literal: the entry goes through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, and the acceptance line about a sorted unsaved list is dropped as resting on a false premise. A list-draft prompt would be a product change to the draft lifetime and is not part of this card.
- Sidebar posture: the sidebar entry now shows on read-only (installed) packages as well, matching item 2's list ⋮ behaviour through the one shared gate. Accepted.
- Not in this card: the phone top-row ⋮ (built in `ObjectView.tsx`) is noted for a later card.
